queries.query: SELECT count(*)::text AS count FROM "GymInvoice" c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "Workspace" w WHERE w.id=c."workspaceId" AND w.type='GYM') AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "WorkspaceMember" m WHERE m.id=c."studentMemberId" AND m."workspaceId"=c."workspaceId" AND m."userId"=c."studentUserId") AND (c."enrollmentId" IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GymEnrollment" e WHERE e.id=c."enrollmentId" AND e."workspaceId"=c."workspaceId" AND e."studentMemberId"=c."studentMemberId")))

SELECT count(*)::text AS count FROM "GymEnrollment" c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "Workspace" w WHERE w.id=c."workspaceId" AND w.type='GYM') AND NOT ((c."billingPayerGuardianId" IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GymGuardian" g WHERE g.id=c."billingPayerGuardianId" AND g."workspaceId"=c."workspaceId" AND g."studentMemberId"=c."studentMemberId")) AND (c."supersedesEnrollmentId" IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GymEnrollment" e WHERE e.id=c."supersedesEnrollmentId" AND e.id<>c.id AND e."workspaceId"=c."workspaceId" AND e."studentMemberId"=c."studentMemberId")))

SELECT count(*)::text AS count FROM "GymContractAcceptance" c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "Workspace" w WHERE w.id=c."workspaceId" AND w.type='GYM') AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GymEnrollment" e JOIN "WorkspaceMember" m ON m.id=e."studentMemberId" WHERE e.id=c."enrollmentId" AND e."workspaceId"=c."workspaceId" AND ((c."representedUserId" IS NULL AND c."signerUserId"=m."userId") OR (c."representedUserId"=m."userId" AND c."signerUserId"<>m."userId" AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GymGuardian" g WHERE g."workspaceId"=e."workspaceId" AND g."studentMemberId"=m.id AND g."guardianUserId"=c."signerUserId")))))

SELECT count(*)::text AS count FROM "GymInvoiceItem" c JOIN "GymInvoice" own ON own.id=c."invoiceId" JOIN "Workspace" w ON w.id=own."workspaceId" WHERE w.type='GYM' AND c."planVersionId" IS NOT NULL AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "GymInvoice" i JOIN "GymPlanVersion" v ON v.id=c."planVersionId" JOIN "GymPlan" p ON p.id=v."planId" WHERE i.id=c."invoiceId" AND i."workspaceId"=p."workspaceId"))
